description: Deletes a block group. `group` is a user group name or a '/'-separated path from the program-blocks root (e.g. Motors/Conveyor; sent as ONE encoded path segment); each level matches the exact name first, then ignoring case. A group that holds any block or subgroup (recursively) is refused with 409 group_not_empty (details.blocks and details.groups list everything that would go) unless recursive:true, which deletes them all; an unknown group is 404 not_found. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it returns the same blocks/groups list as the plan WITHOUT deleting. Maps to DELETE /plcs/{plc}/blockgroups/{group}?recursive=true. M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

group.description: block group name or '/'-separated path (e.g., Motors/Conveyor)

recursive.description: confirm deleting a non-empty group together with every block and subgroup in it

name: tia_block_group_delete
title: TIA — delete block group
